originality.rationale: The full accessible 2014 Gusev primary preprint gives the expected hitting time and pair graph but not this second-moment formula; its mean alone cannot imply variance. Public research-index searches for the specific stochastic second moment, pair collision variance and aliases, and wider literature searches failed to find equivalent statements. Other close published automata results use deterministic shortest words, distributions over random transition maps, or optimal synchronizing probability; none implies a second moment for independent fair inputs of the fixed odd-state Černý pair automaton. Residual priority risk remains because not every possible earlier treatment was accessible.
residual_risks: A variance identity might have been derived in an unindexed or inaccessible treatment of the identical stochastic pair automaton.
Some related probability-function papers were compared at abstract level, not full text; their stated observables differ.
